Messages.Author: SinTax
Messages.Body:
We are kinda unclear about the timing on the Succubus Club. The card text
has the words 'These trades' referring to cards in play and from hand, but
can the "blood donations" occur at any time?

The next question involves Hostile Takeover. Can any Methuselah bid pool
that she doesn't have? Specifically, the controlling meth? (since she pays
only half anyway)

Thanks!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"SinTax" <pchan...@earthlink.net> wrote:
> We are kinda unclear about the timing on the Succubus Club. The card text
> has the words 'These trades' referring to cards in play and from hand, but
> can the "blood donations" occur at any time?

The "blood donations" are "trades", just like the "donations" of cards in
play and from hand. All of these can only occur during your untap.

> The next question involves Hostile Takeover. Can any Methuselah bid pool
> that she doesn't have? Specifically, the controlling meth? (since she pays
> only half anyway)

You can only bid what you can afford to pay. The controlling Meth.
can bid up to 2X if she has X pool, since she can afford that bid.
